$comment: Non-frontmatter dependency edges for installer/init.mjs. The PRIMARY dependency source is agent frontmatter permissions rules (action:"skill" allows = requiresSkills, action:"subagent" allows = delegatesTo). This map covers edges frontmatter cannot express: impliesMcp (skill->MCP: when a skill is installed, the listed MCP server(s) should also be enabled — values MUST match mcp.servers.<key> in opencode_app/opencode.json), requiresSkills (skill->skill: when a skill is installed, the listed skill(s) are auto-installed too, mirroring SKILL.md prerequisite declarations; --no-deps opts out), and shipsPlugins (skill->plugin artifacts: repo plugins/ entries copied into the target's opencode plugin dir so runtime enforcement travels with the skill — opencode targets only; non-opencode targets get a notice; --no-deps opts out. Trailing-slash entries mean the whole directory). The requiresSkills pair must match tests/test_skill_isolation.bats HANDOFF_OWNER/HANDOFF_TARGET (source of truth per AGENTS.md §Skill Isolation Contract); shipsPlugins is a skill->plugin edge, deliberately outside that invariant.
